description: Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Data Management Framework (DMF) export/import pattern: kick off a DMF package export, poll for completion via a scheduled job (not an in-step blocking loop), then download/unzip the resulting package into blob storage; or zip staged files, upload, and trigger an import.
notes: This pack calls an existing D365 credential-broker HTTP endpoint rather than authenticating to D365 directly, to avoid re-deriving D365 auth/Key Vault trust in this platform. Point EXECUTION_LEDGER_D365_BROKER_URL at that broker.

There is no in-step polling loop. A DMF export can take most of an hour; blocking a worker task that long would starve the bounded per-replica concurrency. export-poll is designed to run as its own short scheduled job (see docs/drasi-integration.md) and either completes (export ready) or fails closed (not ready yet / genuinely failed) on each tick.

export-poll's output_schema enforces value in ['Succeeded','PartiallySucceeded'] -- this is what turns 'D365 says NotRun' into a normal job-run failure without needing a dedicated conditional-branch connector.

export-transfer and import-package depend on the http_download and blob_archive connectors added alongside this pack -- rest/erp cannot carry binary payloads, and no connector previously moved an arbitrary URL's bytes into or out of the pipeline.

import-package runs as one job (no poll step) because a single small-package import is synchronous enough; if your import volume needs async status polling too, mirror export-poll's scheduled-job pattern rather than adding a blocking loop.

import-package's get-write-url and upload-package/import-package steps are not adjacent, so the writable URL from get-write-url must be carried forward explicitly into later steps' config -- same constraint documented for export-start's executionId.
